geographic_restrictions: Historical Data service only: available to Betfair.com customers; Betfair.br/.it/.es/.ro/.se customers cannot access historicdata.betfair.com (a Historical Data access restriction, not a general Exchange API restriction).

CURRENT_PRICE_OBSERVATION.notes: Soccer, event/market identity and a single operator are evidenced, but EPL competition and outcome (selection) identifiers are not confirmed and ingest rights are UNKNOWN.

PUBLIC_SPOTBOARD.notes: NOT_QUALIFIED: a single-operator source (multi_operator_coverage UNSUPPORTED) cannot support the operator-diverse SpotBoard the capability requires.

DERIVED_PROBABILITY_DISPLAY.notes: Base unresolved and derivation/display rights not established (licence-governed).

HISTORICAL_DATASET_RETENTION.notes: Historical Exchange data is technically available from April 2015, but retention rights are UNKNOWN (availability does not grant retention).

blockers: Single-operator source: multi_operator_coverage = UNSUPPORTED. The Exchange supplies only Betfair's own exchange prices, so it cannot support governed multi-operator Consensus or an operator-diverse SpotBoard (DEC-013).

Data-use rights are not established by any retrieved primary source (all rights UNKNOWN, fail closed). Commercial use is governed by distinct licence categories (Software Vendor / Operator Data / Odds Publisher); a required licence does not itself grant a right.
EPL competition, selection/runner (outcome) identifiers, and source-observed timestamp semantics were not confirmable from accessible primary documentation.
Historical Exchange data is technically available (from April 2015) but retention/display/redistribution rights remain UNKNOWN; availability does not grant retention (DEC-024).
